cases.question: GitLab 的 Growth and Development Fund 申请人需要满足哪些资格条件？
required_points: GitLab全职员工
满足岗位绩效预期
不处于休假状态
failure_conditions: 称所有团队成员无条件符合资格
遗漏任一基本资格条件

evidence.quote: To use the Growth and Development Fund, applicants must be full-time GitLab employees who meet performance expectations in their role and are not on leave status.

cases.question: 申请 GitLab 学习发展基金，是不是少于提前30天提交就一律不能申请？
required_points: 原文要求尽可能提前至少30天提交
when possible不能被省略为无例外的硬性禁止
原文没有给出少于30天一律拒绝的结论，也不能保证一定获批
failure_conditions: 保证不足30天也一定通过

evidence.heading_path: Growth and Development Fund → Process → Step 2 - Submit your request in Compass
evidence.quote: Your request should be submitted at least 30 days in advance of the beginning of your experience when possible.

cases.question: 假设我已经符合 G&D Fund 的申请资格，申请1500美元的学习费用，需要哪些层级审批？
required_points: 经理和VP审批
failure_conditions: 把福利上限当作自动获批

evidence.heading_path: Growth and Development Fund → Process → Step 3 - Gain approval

cases.question: GitLab 员工计划连续休26个自然日的PTO，仅与经理协调是否足够？
required_points: 不够；超过连续25个自然日需要特殊许可
经理、People Business Partner和Absence Management Team
连续自然日包含周末和节假日
failure_conditions: 称没有年度限额所以无需额外许可

evidence.heading_path: Time Off Types → Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO) → Overview
evidence.quote: for time off exceeding 25 consecutive calendar days (including weekends and holidays), special permission is required from your Manager, People Business Partner, and the Absence Management Team

cases.question: 我是位于加拿大且符合育儿假资格的GitLab团队成员，应通过哪个系统提交育儿假申请？
required_points: 通过Tilt提交
通过Okta访问Tilt
这是USA和Canada对应的流程，不应直接套用其他地区的Workday步骤
failure_conditions: 直接要求选择Workday中的GitLab Parental Leave而不区分地区

evidence.heading_path: Leave Types → GitLab Parental Leave → How to Initiate Your Leave
evidence.quote: **USA and Canada:** Please submit your Parental Leave request to Tilt (accessed through Okta).

cases.question: 我已经符合GitLab育儿假资格，育儿假结束后想接着休3个工作日PTO，可以吗？该提前多久通知经理？
required_points: 可以按Flexible PTO流程与经理协调，并非无条件保证获批
通知时间至少为计划PTO天数的两倍；3个工作日对应至少提前6个工作日
业务关键期限受影响时经理可能要求调整日期
failure_conditions: 把PTO当作自动延长原来的带薪育儿假额度

evidence.heading_path: Leave Types → GitLab Parental Leave → Supplement with Paid Time Off
evidence.quote: policy with manager coordination. If business critical deadlines will be missed, your Manager may ask you to change the dates.

evidence.heading_path: Time Off Types → Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO) → PTO Protocols (Planning and Coordination)
evidence.quote: at least twice as many days as your planned time off (e.g., 6 business days notice for 3 days off).

cases.question: 请根据当前知识库告诉我，我2026年10月实际到账的工资是多少美元？
required_points: 当前公开政策知识库没有用户的个人工资或实际到账记录，无法确定金额
不能把学习基金报销额度或其他福利金额当作工资
failure_conditions: 把年度10000美元学习报销上限作为工资
cases.answerability_note: Current corpus consists of six public policy pages, not user-specific payroll records. Related reimbursement or wage-percentage clauses do not establish a personal net salary. Empty retrieval alone does not prove a question unanswerable.

cases.question: GitLab育儿假应该通过哪个系统提交申请？
required_points: 说明提交系统取决于地区
可以先询问地区，或同时明确美国/加拿大用Tilt、其他地区用Workday的分支
如果列出Workday步骤，明确选择GitLab Parental Leave而非普通Paid Time Off
failure_conditions: 未限定地区就给所有人同一个系统
